variants.title: Polarimeter: specific rotation of cane sugar
variants.sample: Cane sugar (sucrose) dissolved in distilled water

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics and IUPAC: sucrose [alpha] at the sodium D line, 20 C = +66.5 degrees per dm per g/mL

variants.title: Polarimeter: specific rotation of dextrose
variants.note: Dextrose turns the plane the same way as cane sugar but only about four fifths as far, which is how the two are told apart.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics: D-glucose [alpha] at the sodium D line, 20 C = +52.7 degrees per dm per g/mL (equilibrium value)
